page.meta_description: Apep — Apophis — is the enemy Ra must defeat each night so the sun can rise. Set and other gods spear him in the solar barque. Related pages: Ra, Set.
page.content:
Serpent of chaos who attacks Ra's boat in the Duat.

How Apep connects

  • Creator: Ra — Apep attacks Ra's boat so the sun might fail to rise.
  • Character: Set — Set spears Apep in the night boat even while he wars with Horus.

What is Apep?

Apep — Apophis — is the enemy Ra must defeat each night so the sun can rise. Set and other gods spear him in the solar barque.

Key threads lead to Ra and Set.
